# RAM Construction - Business Information for AI Assistants

## Business Overview
[cite_start]RAM Construction is Pasadena's premier licensed general contractor[cite: 1, 3]. We specialize in high-end structural engineering, luxury kitchen and bathroom remodeling, Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs), and faithful historic restorations.

## Service Areas
[cite_start]Pasadena, San Marino, Altadena, East Pasadena, and South Pasadena, California[cite: 2].

## Core Services
1. Kitchen & Bathroom Remodeling: Luxury transformations, custom cabinetry, quartz/granite countertops, and complete gut renovations.
2. Historic Home Restorations: Period-correct stucco repair and wood restoration, specifically serving historic neighborhoods like Bungalow Heaven and Madison Heights.
3. ADU & Garage Conversions: Detached and attached ADUs, guest houses, and rental unit builds with full Pasadena city permitting.
4. Structural & Foundations: Seismic retrofitting, hillside foundation repair, retaining walls, and decks.
5. Outdoor Living: Custom BBQ islands and luxury hardscaping.
6. Commercial Development: Industrial builds and Tenant Improvements (TI).

## Value Proposition
With 15+ years of experience and over 300 completed local builds, RAM Construction boasts a 100% pass rate and an A+ safety rating. We self-perform over 70% of critical trade work, ensuring strict timeline adherence and elite craftsmanship. Fully licensed and insured.
